title: notes
body:
when i hear a word that i dont fully know and want to actually learn it i will write it down in here

abject

use case: abject misery

means very bad, you have regular Misery. and then abject misery. it always means bad so its not just a multiplier. you cant have abject happiness, thats an oxymoron

adjunct

use case: adjunct professor

something that is additional and helpful but not required. an adjunct professor is someone who does miscellaneous classes

pecuniary

use case: a pecuniary shot to the arm

relating to money, he has a pecuniary interest in the company. that sorta thing.
